subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a new durable session process/step event API, or extend the existing agent item/tool/session event streams to cover this use case?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the permanent contract controls protocol shape, persistence, replay, authorization, redaction, and overlap with existing progress streams.

options.title: Design a process-event contract
options.body: Create an additive session process/step API with explicit permissions, redaction, persistence, replay, and source mappings before implementation.

options.title: Extend existing streams
options.body: Keep the taxonomy smaller by making agent item/tool/session events durable and replayable enough for clients to use as the source of truth.

options.title: Defer to narrower issues
options.body: Leave this broad contract open while solving only specific progress gaps like inter-session streaming or CLI stdout events in separate designs.

recommendation.title: Design a process-event contract
recommendation.body: Create an additive session process/step API with explicit permissions, redaction, persistence, replay, and source mappings before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the structured execution item/event history and broad agent/runtime event surface.
